sections.title: Prerequisite Recap: The Area of a Parallelogram
lecture_lines: [Asset: Det_Intro] Determinants measure the area of a parallelogram.
[Asset: Parallelogram_Visual] Vectors v1 and v2 define the space.
[Asset: Formula_Display] Area equals the absolute determinant value.
animations: Fade in parallelogram with vectors v1, v2 as defined in.
Highlight vector v1 in #FFD700 and v2 in #00FFFF.
Label base b in #FFFFFF and height h in #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Geometric Setup: Solving Ax = b
lecture_lines: [Asset: Vector_Eq] We solve the system: x v1 + y v2 = b.
[Asset: Vector_Combo] Visualize v1 and v2 as grid builders.
[Asset: Target_Vector] Aiming to reach the target vector b.
animations: Display system Ax = b in #FFFFFF.
Show vectors v1 and v2 as grid builders from.
Animate vector appearing at origin then moving using.
Visualize Ax = b as vector addition towards.
Highlight intersection of components in #FFD700.

sections.title: The Substitution Intuition
lecture_lines: [Asset: Ratio_Concept] Cramer's Rule uses a ratio of areas.
[Asset: Replace_Col] Replace one column with target vector b.
[Asset: Scaling_Area] The new area is scaled by x.
[Asset: Final_Ratio] x equals the ratio of these areas.
[Asset: Cramer_Full] This logic defines Cramer's Rule geometrically.
animations: Show determinant ratio in #FFFFFF.
Replace column of A with vector b.
Animate area scaling by x in #FFD700.
Display final ratio equation.
Highlight result with flash.

sections.title: Visual Proof: Areas in Ratio
lecture_lines: [Asset: Scaling_Visual] Scaling a basis vector scales the area.
[Asset: Slide_B] Slide vector b along the span.
[Asset: Area_Linearity] Area changes linearly with x.
[Asset: Isolated_X] The variable x becomes geometrically isolated.
[Asset: Proof_Complete] This completes our geometric proof.
animations: Show scaling visual in #FFFFFF.
Slide vector b along span in #00FFFF.
Show area linearity comparison in adjacent cells D3, D4.
Isolate variable x with bold border.
Flash result in #FFD700.

sections.title: Summary and Geometric Constraint
lecture_lines: [Asset: Zero_Det] If determinant is zero, area collapses.
[Asset: Collinear_Vectors] The vectors v1 and v2 are collinear.
[Asset: Unique_Fail] No unique solution exists in this case.
animations: Display zero determinant formula in #FF0000.
Show vectors v1 and v2 as collinear.
Highlight unique solution failure message in #FFFFFF.
